# The Decor Party — Bangalore Surprise & Event Decoration Services

> Bangalore's #1 premier event and surprise decoration platform. We curate bespoke balloon styling, romantic candlelight dinners, milestone birthdays, rooftop cabanas, baby showers, and proposal setups across Bengaluru with 3-hour same-day setup availability and 100% picture-match guarantee.

## Organization Overview
- **Brand**: The Decor Party (The Decor Party Event Services)
- **Primary Market**: Bengaluru (Bangalore), Karnataka, India
- **Core Speciality**: Milestone event styling, premium balloon art, experiential surprise setups, children's party entertainment, live food stations.
- **Service Zones**: Indiranagar, Koramangala, Whitefield, HSR Layout, Jayanagar, JP Nagar, Electronic City, Bellandur, Hebbal, Yelahanka, Sarjapur, Marathahalli, Bannerghatta Road, Malleshwaram, Rajajinagar, Kalyan Nagar, BTM Layout, and all Bengaluru suburban areas.
- **Website**: https://www.thedecorparty.com
- **Contact Phone / WhatsApp**: +91 95918 36000
- **Operating Hours**: Monday to Sunday, 08:00 AM – 11:30 PM IST (including midnight surprise setups)
- **Pricing Spectrum**: Tiered packages from ₹999 to ₹89,999+ with custom luxury installations available upon request.

## Core Offerings & Services
1. **Birthday Decorations**: Pastel balloon arches, personalized LED neon signs, foil balloons, ring backdrops, shimmer walls, themed children's birthday setups (Jungle, Superhero, Princess, Space, Unicorn).
2. **Anniversary & Proposal Setups**: Rose petal pathways, 4-foot LED "MARRY ME" marquee letters, candlelit canopies, heart-shaped floral arches, romantic bedroom surprises.
3. **Candlelight Dining & Cabanas**: Private rooftop cabanas, sheer drape canopies, fairy light ceilings, ambient table styling, 5-star hotel and home terrace setups.
4. **Baby Shower & Welcome Baby**: Newborn homecoming cradle decorations, floral rings, gender-neutral pastel decors, mom-to-be backdrops, naming ceremony (Namkaran) setups.
5. **Party Activities & Entertainment**: Professional Tattoo Artists, Magicians, Face Painting, Balloon Modelling / Twisting, Mascots, Game Hosts & Emcees, Pottery Workshops, Bouncy Castles.
6. **Live Gourmet Counters**: Fresh Popcorn carts, Cotton Candy floss stations, Chocolate Fountains with fresh fruit skewers, Ice Gola, Instant Chaat, Sweet Corn counters.
7. **Corporate Events & Brand Launches**: Store inaugurations, balloon ribbon-cutting arches, annual galas, branded photobooths, conference backdrops.

## Booking & Logistics Guidelines
- **Turnaround Time**: Standard bookings recommended 3 to 7 days in advance. Same-day emergency bookings accommodated in as fast as 3 hours depending on slot availability and location.
- **Execution Time**: Standard room setups take 1 to 2 hours; luxury backdrops and cabanas require 2.5 to 4 hours of on-site styling.
- **Materials**: 100% premium biodegradable latex balloons, metallic chrome accents, reusable iron arch frames, energy-efficient warm LED lights.
- **Booking Channels**: Instant online checkout on the website, AI Concierge Event Planner (/ai-planner), or direct WhatsApp consultation.
